# AutoForge Hermes — Complete LLM Reference

## Overview

AutoForge Hermes is a reusable Hermes Agent skill package that adapts the AutoForge-style autonomous coding loop into native Hermes primitives.

Core workflow:

```text
idea → product spec → features.yaml → validation → Hermes Kanban → builders → reviewers → release evidence
```

The project is not a fork of `AutoForgeAI/autoforge` and does not copy Claude Agent SDK implementation code. It is a workflow translation for Hermes Agent.

- Author: Maxim Osovsky (https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q107189449)
- Repository: https://github.com/maximosovsky/AutoForge
- License: MIT

## Main Skill

Runtime skill path:

```text
hermes/skills/autoforge-hermes/SKILL.md
```

Skill name:

```text
autoforge-hermes
```

Use the skill when a user asks to design, specify, or build a project using a spec-first AutoForge-style Hermes workflow.

## Install

Verified full package install:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/maximosovsky/AutoForge.git
cd AutoForge
python hermes/scripts/validate-skill.py
bash hermes/scripts/install-local.sh
```

Single-file raw install:

```bash
HERMES_HOME="${HERMES_HOME:-$HOME/.hermes}"
mkdir -p "$HERMES_HOME/skills/software-development/autoforge-hermes"
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/maximosovsky/AutoForge/main/hermes/skills/autoforge-hermes/SKILL.md \
  > "$HERMES_HOME/skills/software-development/autoforge-hermes/SKILL.md"
```

Reload skills after install:

```text
/reload-skills
```

or start a new Hermes session.

## Artifact Contract

A target project using this workflow should contain:

```text
.hermes/autoforge/app_spec.md
.hermes/autoforge/system_view.md
.hermes/autoforge/features.yaml
.hermes/autoforge/review_policy.md
.hermes/autoforge/worker_prompt.md
.hermes/autoforge/status.json
```

### app_spec.md

Product source of truth: goal, users, journeys, screens/routes, data model, permissions, integrations, design direction, non-goals, and success criteria.

### system_view.md

Visual/system source of truth: project boundary, main elements, component diagram, data flow, integration points, and architectural constraints.

### features.yaml

Feature graph imported into Hermes Kanban. Every feature should have:

- stable `id`;
- `title`;
- `type`;
- `depends_on` list;
- `acceptance` criteria;
- `verification` steps.

### review_policy.md

Completion gates: lint/format, typecheck when applicable, build, tests, browser/API checks, persistence checks for data features, no unexplained mock/in-memory production stores, security/access review, git diff review, and Kanban evidence.

### worker_prompt.md

Instructions for builder workers: read spec/features/review policy, work on one assigned feature, implement the smallest complete change, verify before completion, and block honestly if needed.

### status.json

Machine-readable marker that the spec phase is complete.

## Repository Structure

| Path | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `README.md` | Public GitHub cover page. |
| `ARCHITECTURE.md` | AutoForge-to-Hermes mapping and workflow architecture. |
| `TRY_IT.md` | Step-by-step smoke test and Kanban import guide. |
| `hermes/skills/autoforge-hermes/SKILL.md` | Runtime Hermes skill. |
| `hermes/scripts/validate-skill.py` | Skill package validator. |
| `hermes/scripts/install-local.sh` | Local installer for the full skill folder. |
| `.github/workflows/ci.yml` | GitHub Actions validation workflow. |
| `scripts/check_autoforge_layout.py` | Validates `.hermes/autoforge` project artifacts. |
| `scripts/scaffold_project.py` | Creates the six `.hermes/autoforge` artifact files for a new target project. |
| `scripts/import_features_to_kanban.py` | Imports features into Hermes Kanban. |
| `examples/tiny-notes/.hermes/autoforge/` | Minimal smoke sample. |
| `tests/` | Unit tests for validator, scaffold, importer, docs, and skill package contract. |

## Smoke Test

```bash
python hermes/scripts/validate-skill.py
python scripts/check_autoforge_layout.py examples/tiny-notes
python scripts/import_features_to_kanban.py examples/tiny-notes \
  --board autoforge-tiny-notes \
  --name 'AutoForge Tiny Notes' \
  --idempotency-prefix autoforge-tiny \
  --dry-run
python -m unittest discover -s tests -q
```

Expected:

```text
PASS ... SKILL.md is a valid autoforge-hermes Hermes skill
PASS examples\tiny-notes has 4 AutoForge-style features and valid dependencies
Ran 15 tests ... OK
```

## Kanban Import

The importer validates `features.yaml`, creates one Hermes Kanban card per feature, adds idempotency keys, and links dependencies.

Example:

```bash
python scripts/import_features_to_kanban.py examples/tiny-notes \
  --board autoforge-tiny-notes \
  --name 'AutoForge Tiny Notes' \
  --idempotency-prefix autoforge-tiny \
  --json
```

## Design Rules

- Spec comes before implementation.
- No implementation before user approval unless explicitly requested.
- Builders work one ready feature at a time.
- Reviewers verify independently.
- Tasks are marked complete only with evidence.
- UI work requires browser verification.
- CRUD/data work requires refresh/restart persistence verification.
- Mock/in-memory production data paths must be justified or removed.

## Roadmap

Completed:

- AutoForge-to-Hermes mapping.
- Tiny Notes smoke artifact set.
- Layout/dependency validator.
- Hermes Kanban importer.
- Reusable Hermes skill package.
- Public README, install instructions, license, and LLM discovery files.
- Project scaffold/template generator.
- CI workflow for validation and tests.

Planned:

- Optional dispatcher examples for bounded builder/reviewer workers.
